findings.evidence: The definition body is `DoubleCoset.quotientCongr Γ K (restrictedProductCongrRight U U' φ hφ) rfl rfl`, and repository grep finds `doubleCosetCongrRight` only in this declaration, its two lemmas, and the module docstring.
findings.fix: Delete lines 73–121 and use the three `DoubleCoset.quotientCongr*` declarations directly, as the finite-adelic constructions already do.
findings.issue: `doubleCosetCongrRight` is exactly `DoubleCoset.quotientCongr` specialized to `restrictedProductCongrRight`; its two representative lemmas likewise restate `quotientCongr_apply_mk` and `quotientCongr_symm_apply_mk`, and no new code uses this wrapper.

findings.evidence: `TauCeti/Topology/Algebra/RestrictedProduct/Diagonal.lean:132` proves exactly `(restrictedProductCongrRight U V ψ hψ).toMonoidHom.comp (rationalDiagonal φ U hU) = rationalDiagonal (fun i ↦ (ψ i).toMonoidHom.comp (φ i)) V …`; all three blocks instead expand applications and perform `ext … p` plus `restrictedProductCongrRight_apply`.
findings.fix: Use `restrictedProductCongrRight_comp_rationalDiagonal`, then rewrite the component homomorphisms with `hdiag`; apply the resulting homomorphism equality to `MonoidHom.map_range`.
findings.issue: Each of the orthogonal, Spin, and special-orthogonal congruence proofs (lines 179–188, 204–211, and 230–239) re-derives coordinatewise how `restrictedProductCongrRight` composes with a rational diagonal.

summary: The PR introduces an unused restricted-product wrapper around the existing generic double-coset equivalence and repeats an existing diagonal-composition argument three times.
